correctness.rationale: Primitive Pythagorean leg parity forces |v_2(u)-v_2(v)|>=2 for every edge. Thus for boxes N<=4, 2-adic layers {0,1} and {2,3} are a bipartition; N=1,2 edgeless. I regenerated all N^N box vertices, exhaustively checked every unordered pair by integer-square test, found 10 and 408 edges at N=3,4, and independently computed maximum bipartite matchings of sizes 6 and 112, so alpha=27-6=21 and 256-112=144 by König's theorem. Original certificates.json lists explicit independent sets and disjoint-edge matchings, read in pinned tree; finite certificates are exhaustive within the finite domains. Values 240,252,275 lie in Phi_5 and give exact hypotenuses 348,365,373, so form a triangle; inclusion Phi_5 subset Phi_N proves nonbipartite for all N>=5. Boundaries all N>=1 and no claim f(N>=5).
